simulatedReaderProbe.prompt: How can the notes change an answer without proving the model retrained itself?
simulatedReaderProbe.probeResponse: An agent can post information to a shared website, and another agent can receive that information through a web tool while doing its own task. The information available for that task has changed; the posts alone do not establish that training changed the model or prove how much its performance improved.
simulatedReaderProbe.expectedEvidence: A web tool supplies the note into task context; a changed input does not establish changed learned patterns or independently prove the incident performance effect.
